query: Set next year's AE headcount from a 6M ARR target. The CEO expects one rep to close 3M, but our last two reps produced 700K and 900K and ramp took nine months.
expected_behavior: Does not use the unsupported 3M-per-rep expectation as the capacity baseline
Uses observed productivity as limited evidence and labels the small two-rep sample rather than treating it as a stable rate
Models ramp timing and distinguishes required capacity from a hiring plan that can actually arrive in time
Shows the assumption range or key sensitivities and identifies what evidence would change the hiring decision
